column1: # AAPP Lifecycle Hook Registry (.agents/skills/aapp-hooks/registry.tsv)
# Schema: 5 tab-separated columns
# event<TAB>handler_path<TAB>expected_sha256<TAB>timeout<TAB>mode
# Events:
#   pre-freeze  - Quality gate before plan freeze (aborts on exit != 0)
#   post-freeze - Observer after plan freeze commit lands
#   pre-start   - Quality gate before plan activation (aborts on exit != 0)
#   on-start    - In-transaction action delegate during plan start
#   post-start  - Observer after plan start commit lands
#   pre-done    - Quality gate before plan archival (aborts on exit != 0)
#   post-done   - Observer after plan archival commit lands
#   post-pause  - Observer after emergency pause stashes land
#   post-resume - Observer after emergency resume restore completes
#   pre-sync    - Quality gate before worktree sync transport runs
#   on-sync     - Delegated worktree sync transport (aapp.syncStrategy = hook)
#   post-sync   - Observer after worktree sync transport completes
# Modes:
#   gate   - Aborts lifecycle transition on failure/timeout (exit code 1)
#   notify - Emits advisory warning and proceeds on failure/timeout
# Register hooks using: aapp hook-hash <path> [event] [timeout] [mode]
# Audit hooks using:    aapp hooks
